subject: Mathematics
title: Circles
summary: Circle un points ka locus hai jo ek fixed point (centre) se fixed doori (radius) par hain. General equation x² + y² + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0 ka centre (−g, −f) aur radius √(g² + f² − c) hai.
Point ya line ki circle ke relative position S₁ = x₁² + y₁² + 2gx₁ + 2fy₁ + c se, aur centre se distance ko radius se compare karke tay hoti hai.
Tangent, normal, chord of contact, tangent ki length, common tangents, family of circles aur orthogonal circles JEE ke main tools hain. Diameter form aur chord length bhi aksar poochhe jaate hain.

formulas.name: Standard and general form
formulas.formula: (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r²;  x² + y² + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0 → centre (−g, −f), r = √(g² + f² − c)
formulas.mistake: Real circle ke liye g² + f² − c ≥ 0 zaroori hai — check karna mat bhoolna.

formulas.name: Diameter form
formulas.when: Do points ko jodne wali line diameter ho to circle.

formulas.name: Parametric form
formulas.formula: x = h + r cos θ, y = k + r sin θ

formulas.name: Position of a point
formulas.formula: S₁ > 0 outside;  S₁ = 0 on;  S₁ < 0 inside

formulas.name: Line and circle
formulas.formula: distance p of centre from line: p > r no intersection;  p = r tangent;  p < r secant;  chord length = 2√(r² − p²)

formulas.name: Tangent condition
formulas.formula: y = mx + c touches x² + y² = a² iff c² = a²(1 + m²);  tangent: y = mx ± a√(1 + m²)

formulas.name: Tangent at a point
formulas.formula: T = 0: xx₁ + yy₁ + g(x + x₁) + f(y + y₁) + c = 0

formulas.name: Chord of contact and midpoint chord
formulas.formula: chord of contact from (x₁, y₁): T = 0;  chord with midpoint (x₁, y₁): T = S₁
formulas.when: Bahar ke point ya midpoint se chords.

formulas.name: Two circles
formulas.formula: d > r₁ + r₂: 4 common tangents;  d = r₁ + r₂: 3;  |r₁ − r₂| < d < r₁ + r₂: 2;  d = |r₁ − r₂|: 1;  d < |r₁ − r₂|: 0

formulas.name: Orthogonal circles
formulas.when: Right angle par katne wale circles.

formulas.name: Family of circles
formulas.formula: S + λL = 0 (circle and line);  S₁ + λS₂ = 0 (two circles);  radical axis S₁ − S₂ = 0
formulas.when: Intersection points se guzarne wale circles.

examples.title: Centre aur radius
examples.problem: x² + y² − 4x + 6y − 12 = 0 ka centre aur radius nikalo.

examples.title: Tangent ki length
examples.problem: (7, 2) se upar wale circle tak tangent ki length?

examples.title: Chord ki length
examples.problem: Ek line x² + y² = 25 ke centre se 3 doori par hai. Chord length?

examples.title: Common tangents
examples.problem: Radii 3 aur 4 wale circles ke centres 10 door hain. Common tangents kitne?

examples.title: Diye slope ka tangent
examples.problem: x² + y² = 9 ke slope 1 wale tangents?

examples.title: Teen points se circle
examples.problem: (0, 0), (2, 0) aur (0, 4) se guzarne wala circle nikalo.

topics.title: Conditions for a general second-degree equation to be a circle
topics.explain: ax² + 2hxy + by² + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0 circle hai agar a = b ≠ 0 aur h = 0 (aur radius real ho).

topics.title: Normal to a circle
topics.explain: Har normal centre se guzarta hai. (x₁, y₁) par normal wo line hai jo (x₁, y₁) ko centre se jodti hai.

topics.title: Director circle
topics.explain: Jin points se x² + y² = a² par perpendicular tangents khinchte hain unka locus x² + y² = 2a² hai.

topics.title: Radical axis and centre
topics.explain: Radical axis un points ka locus hai jinki do circles tak tangent lengths barabar hain: S₁ − S₂ = 0, line of centres ke perpendicular. Teen circles ke radical axes radical centre par milte hain.

topics.title: Angle between circles
topics.explain: cos θ = (r₁² + r₂² − d²)/(2r₁r₂), jahan θ intersection point par radii ke beech angle hai; θ = 90° orthogonality condition deta hai.

topics.title: Common chord
topics.explain: Do katne wale circles ki common chord S₁ − S₂ = 0 hai; iski length kisi bhi centre se distance lekar nikaalte hain.

ratta: y = mx ± a√(1 + m²) tangent to x² + y² = a².
Common tangents: 4, 3, 2, 1, 0 as circles move closer.
